articles.title: Ursula K. Le Guin on the Meaning of Life
articles.highlight: 我们从这一切中诞生，成为被一种意识束缚的生物，这种意识要求我们为自身的生存赋予意义。
articles.summary: 文章借勒古恩的观点指出，生命的意义不会像施舍一样从冷漠的宇宙中落下，也无法从伟大书籍、伟大导师、常春藤学费或硅谷商品中现成获得。它值得读，是因为它把意义重新放回人类自身：幸存者必须自己承担为生存赋予意义的任务。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键提醒：意义不是外部发放的现成答案，而是需要个人自己解释、建构并承担的责任。
articles.sourceExcerpt: We are the survivors of immense and minute events — violent cosmic collisions and subtle genetic mutations, the deaths of innumerable suns and the births of innumerable cells, the splitting of continents and the splitting of atoms. Out of it all, we emerged as creatures muzzled by a consciousness that demands we give meaning to our survival. It will not come like alms dropped from the unfeeling hand of the universe.

en.highlight: Out of it all, we emerged as creatures muzzled by a consciousness that demands we give meaning to our survival.
en.summary: Drawing on Le Guin, the article argues that the meaning of life will not arrive like alms from an unfeeling universe, nor can it be found ready-made in great books, great teachers, Ivy League tuition, or Silicon Valley products. It is worth reading because it returns meaning to human beings themselves: survivors must take on the task of giving meaning to their survival.
en.failureAnalysis: The key takeaway: meaning is not an answer delivered from outside; it is a responsibility that individuals must interpret, construct, and bear themselves.

en.highlight: AI models are solving more mathematical problems, and a pattern is emerging in their successes that could help predict which problems they will solve next.
en.summary: This piece looks at how AI models are improving on mathematical problems, and argues that their successes follow a recognizable pattern rather than being random. The value of that pattern is prediction: it may tell us which kinds of problems a model can handle next and which it cannot. For anyone judging the real boundaries of AI capability, that is a finer lens than an overall score.
en.failureAnalysis: The practical takeaway: the useful signal is the structure of which problems get solved, not a single aggregate accuracy number. When reading, check which problem types the sample covers and how success is defined.
